item.title: fix(agents): include ctimeMs in workspace file cache identity (#127769)
item.summary: fix(agents): include ctimeMs in workspace file cache identity (#127769) A same-inode, equal-size in-place edit whose mtime is restored (via sync/restore/editor tooling) left the workspace bootstrap cache serving stale content for the lifetime of the process. ctimeMs is updated by the OS on every metadata change and cannot be restored via utimes, so adding it to the cache identity detects the edit. Matches the existing ctime freshness pattern in assistant-avatar-cache.ts and plugin-registry-snapshot.ts. Closes #127504
